component.name: OxideZap
component.summary: A lightweight WhatsApp Web desktop client for Linux

description.p: OxideZap wraps the official WhatsApp Web interface in a native desktop shell built with Rust and GPUI.

It supports multiple isolated accounts, a system tray, native notifications, an application lock, and a native settings window. The WhatsApp Web page runs in WebKitGTK; the shell does not bundle a second browser engine.
